The installed proxy_tools 0.1.0 wheel metadata labels the package MIT, while its upstream LICENSE.txt contains the original BSD redistribution notice. The upstream text is preserved verbatim, including its original formatting; the project does not replace it with a fabricated MIT notice.

The CPython document includes its incorporated-software acknowledgements, including libffi and libmpdec. OpenSSL, zlib, and Expat files are from the versions reported by this release runtime. These license copies do not claim that every optional upstream tool is bundled.
